name: Excessive visible controls
summary: Show the few frequent actions and move the rest into a menu or reveal them on hover and selection.
problem: A toolbar of a dozen always-visible icons makes every action equal, increases scanning time and breaks on narrow widths.

bad.description: A toolbar with fourteen icon buttons, all visible at once.

good.title: Frequent plus menu
good.description: Three common actions and a More menu for the rest. Try the menu.

good.title: Context menu
good.description: Item actions live in a context menu opened from the row, with shortcuts shown inside it.

why: Contextual and dynamic controls reduce what users must scan while keeping every action reachable.
exceptions: Dense editors and expert tools may keep a full formatting toolbar when users need one-click access, or when users arranged it themselves.
Keep every action reachable by keyboard and a menu, even when it is hidden.

humanReview: Is every visible control frequent enough to deserve permanent space?
